name: What are the risks of neglecting seasonal home maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks of neglecting seasonal home maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neglecting seasonal home maintenance can lead to a variety of serious and costly problems. Untreated roof damage can cause leaks, leading to water damage and mold. Clogged gutters can result in foundation damage or basement flooding. Unserviced HVAC systems can fail, leading to inefficient operation or costly breakdowns. Over time, minor issues can compound, creating significant structural damage, health hazards, and decreasing your home's safety and value, often resulting in more expensive emergency repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Neglecting maintenance risks costly issues like leaks, foundation damage, HVAC failure, structural problems, and decreased home value, often leading to expensive emergency repairs.
